contents.reason: This result is about ring epimorphisms and module restriction of scalars rather than the existence-theorem machinery; its extension-of-scalars construction is licensed by tensor-products-of-modules, which is outside this page's declared prerequisite closure.

contents.name: Example 4.5.13(v), sheafification exhibits sheaves as a reflective subcategory of presheaves
contents.reason: The result requires presheaves, sheaves, and the sheafification construction, all deliberately scheduled on the licensing page presheaves-sheaves-stalks-and-sheafification; importing them here would duplicate that later foundation.

contents.name: Example 4.5.13(vi), the nerve identifies categories as a reflective subcategory of simplicial sets satisfying the Segal condition
contents.reason: The Segal-condition characterisation requires the category of simplicial sets and its nerve, not simplicial complexes or simplicial homology. No planned page in plan-spec.json explicitly licenses this simplicial-set categorical construction.
